title: HSK 2.10 · 年轻, 科学家, 早餐, 校长, 青少年
focus: 短 · 脚 · 市 · 讨论 · 假 · 嘴 · 就要 · 省 · 海 · 夜 · 称 · 年轻 · 晚安 · 科学 · 科 · 轻 · 地球 · 早就 · 球队 · 安静 · 作业 · 家长 · 早餐 · 早晨 · 作家 · 地铁 · 平安 · 队长 · 青年 · 校长 · 市长 · 周年 · 科学家 · 篮球 · 晚餐 · 晚会 · 少年 · 青少年 · 平常
body:
Time of day (早 early, 晚 late), people by role (家, 长) and youth (年, 青, 少). 长 here is always zhǎng 'head of': 家长, 队长, 校长, 市长.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 年 | nián | year | 年轻, 青年, 周年, 少年, 青少年 |
| 长 | zhǎng | head, chief | 家长, 队长, 校长, 市长 |
| 早 | zǎo | early, morning (日 sun + 十) | 早就, 早餐, 早晨 |
| 晚 | wǎn | late, evening (日 + 免 miǎn sound) | 晚安, 晚餐, 晚会 |
| 科 | kē | branch of study (禾 grain + 斗 measure) | 科, 科学, 科学家 |
| 平 | píng | flat, peaceful | 平安, 平常 |
| 球 | qiú | ball (王 jade + 求 qiú sound) | 地球, 球队, 篮球 |
| 家 | jiā | home; -ist (expert) | 家长, 作家, 科学家 |

## Watch out

- 假 is jiǎ 'fake' (假的) but jià 'holiday' (放假).
- 省 has 少 few on top of 目 eye; read shěng for 'save' and 'province'.
- 少年 is shàonián (4th tone): 少 shào 'young' here, not shǎo 'few'.

cards.Example: 我的头发很短。 wǒ de tóufa hěn duǎn: My hair is short
cards.Notes: 矢 arrow + 豆 dòu (sound): measured by arrow length, short. Opposite: 长 cháng

cards.Example: 我的脚很疼。 wǒ de jiǎo hěn téng: My foot hurts
cards.Notes: 月 body + 却 què (sound) = foot. 月 on the left means body/flesh

cards.Example: 我住在上海市。 wǒ zhù zài Shànghǎi shì: I live in Shanghai
cards.Notes: Originally a market; now also a city: 城市, 市长. Lookalike: 布 bù cloth

cards.Example: 我们讨论一下。 wǒmen tǎolùn yíxià: Let's discuss it
cards.Notes: 讨 ask, seek (讠 speech) + 论 discuss (讠 + 仑 lún, sound) = talk it over

cards.Example: 我们明天放假。 wǒmen míngtiān fàngjià: We're off tomorrow
cards.Notes: 亻 person + right part (sound). jiǎ fake (假的); jià holiday (放假, 请假)

cards.Example: 把嘴张开。 bǎ zuǐ zhāngkāi: Open your mouth
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 觜 zī (sound, 'beak') = mouth

cards.Example: 我们就要到了。 wǒmen jiùyào dào le: We're almost there
cards.Notes: 就 soon + 要 will = about to; ends with 了: 就要…了

cards.Example: 这样省钱。 zhèyàng shěng qián: This saves money
cards.Notes: 少 few on top of 目 eye. To save (省钱, 省时间); a province (广东省)

cards.Example: 我想去海边。 wǒ xiǎng qù hǎibiān: I want to go to the seaside
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 每 měi (sound) = sea. In 上海

cards.Example: 昨天我工作到深夜。 zuótiān wǒ gōngzuò dào shēnyè: I worked late into the night yesterday
cards.Notes: 亠 + 亻 + 夕-like part (dusk, moon): night. 夜里, 半夜 midnight

cards.Example: 大家称他老王。 dàjiā chēng tā Lǎo Wáng: Everyone calls him Lao Wang
cards.Notes: 禾 grain + 尔: weighing grain, then 'to name'. 称为 = to be called

cards.Example: 她看起来很年轻。 tā kàn qǐlai hěn niánqīng: She looks young
cards.Notes: 年 years + 轻 light = light in years, young

cards.Example: 晚安，明天见。 wǎn'ān, míngtiān jiàn: Good night, see you tomorrow
cards.Notes: 晚 evening + 安 peace = peaceful evening, good night

cards.Example: 我喜欢科学。 wǒ xǐhuan kēxué: I like science
cards.Notes: 科 branch of study + 学 learning = science

cards.Example: 你学什么科？ nǐ xué shénme kē: What subject do you study?
cards.Notes: 禾 grain + 斗 measure: sorting grain by grade, so a category. 内科 internal medicine

cards.Example: 这个包很轻。 zhège bāo hěn qīng: This bag is light
cards.Notes: 车 vehicle + 又 over 工 (from 巠 jīng, sound) = a light cart. Opposite: 重 zhòng

cards.Example: 地球是圆的。 dìqiú shì yuán de: The Earth is round
cards.Notes: 地 earth, ground + 球 ball = the earth ball, the globe

cards.Example: 我早就知道了。 wǒ zǎojiù zhīdào le: I knew that ages ago
cards.Notes: 早 early + 就 already = long since

cards.Example: 这是我们的球队。 zhè shì wǒmen de qiúduì: This is our team
cards.Notes: 球 ball + 队 team = ball team

cards.Example: 请安静！ qǐng ānjìng: Quiet, please!
cards.Notes: 安 peace (宀 roof + 女 woman) + 静 still (青 qīng + 争) = quiet

cards.Example: 作业写完了吗？ zuòyè xiě wán le ma: Is your homework done?
cards.Notes: 作 do + 业 work, task = assigned work, homework

cards.Example: 明天开家长会。 míngtiān kāi jiāzhǎng huì: Parents' meeting is tomorrow
cards.Notes: 家 family + 长 head (zhǎng) = the head of the family, parent

cards.Example: 你吃早餐了吗？ nǐ chī zǎocān le ma: Have you had breakfast?
cards.Notes: 早 morning + 餐 meal (食 food at the bottom) = breakfast. More formal than 早饭

cards.Example: 早晨的空气很好。 zǎochen de kōngqì hěn hǎo: The morning air is fresh
cards.Notes: 早 early + 晨 dawn (日 sun + 辰 chén, sound) = early morning

cards.Example: 他是有名的作家。 tā shì yǒumíng de zuòjiā: He's a famous writer
cards.Notes: 作 create, write + 家 expert = a professional writer

cards.Example: 我坐地铁上班。 wǒ zuò dìtiě shàngbān: I take the subway to work
cards.Notes: 地 ground (under) + 铁 iron, rail (钅 metal) = underground railway

cards.Example: 祝你一路平安！ zhù nǐ yí lù píng'ān: Have a safe trip!
cards.Notes: 平 calm + 安 safe = safe and sound

cards.Example: 他是我们的队长。 tā shì wǒmen de duìzhǎng: He's our captain
cards.Notes: 队 team + 长 head (zhǎng) = team leader

cards.Example: 他是一个好青年。 tā shì yí ge hǎo qīngnián: He's a fine young man
cards.Notes: 青 green, young + 年 years = youth (roughly 18 to 40)

cards.Example: 校长在开会。 xiàozhǎng zài kāihuì: The principal is in a meeting
cards.Notes: 校 school (木 + 交 jiāo, sound) + 长 head = head of school

cards.Example: 市长来了。 shìzhǎng lái le: The mayor is here
cards.Notes: 市 city + 长 head (zhǎng) = mayor

cards.Example: 今天是十周年。 jīntiān shì shí zhōunián: Today is the 10th anniversary
cards.Notes: 周 full circle + 年 year = a full year round, anniversary

cards.Example: 我想当科学家。 wǒ xiǎng dāng kēxuéjiā: I want to be a scientist
cards.Notes: 科学 science + 家 expert = scientist

cards.Example: 我们去打篮球吧。 wǒmen qù dǎ lánqiú ba: Let's go play basketball
cards.Notes: 篮 basket (⺮ bamboo + 监, sound) + 球 ball = basketball

cards.Example: 晚餐吃什么？ wǎncān chī shénme: What's for dinner?
cards.Notes: 晚 evening + 餐 meal = dinner. More formal than 晚饭

cards.Example: 今晚有个晚会。 jīnwǎn yǒu ge wǎnhuì: There's a party tonight
cards.Notes: 晚 evening + 会 gathering = evening party. 春节晚会 Spring Festival Gala

cards.Example: 他是个少年。 tā shì ge shàonián: He's a teenager
cards.Notes: 少 young (shào here, not shǎo) + 年 years = young in years

cards.Example: 这本书适合青少年。 zhè běn shū shìhé qīngshàonián: This book suits teens
cards.Notes: 青年 youth + 少年 juvenile combined = teenagers

cards.Example: 他平常很早起床。 tā píngcháng hěn zǎo qǐchuáng: He usually gets up early
cards.Notes: 平 ordinary + 常 often, usual = usual, ordinary
